OnLINE COURSE

THE ASTRONOMICAL SOCIETY FOR TRAINING, RESEARCH AND OUTREACH (ASTRO) invites interested students to register for our "New Online Course on SPACE EXPLORERS for School Children".

This is an introductory coursework dealing exclusively Observational, Positional and Practical Astronomy! No prior learning experience is needed.

Astronomy Summer School by Professional Astronomers

LEARN ASTRONOMY from Professional Astronomers

The Astronomical Society for Training Research and Outreach (ASTRO) invites primary, middle, and high school students to express their interest in attending our Astronomy Summer School program this summer. This program is designed to encourage students to learn about astronomy fun and engagingly, incorporating theoretical concepts and practical learning activities! Open for all ages who are willing to learn and explore space and astronomy!

ASTRO SCHOOL

LEARN ASTRONOMY ON WEEKENDS! from Professional Astronomers

The Astronomical Society for Training, Research and Outreach (ASTRO) invites primary, middle, and high school students to express their interest in attending our "ASTRO School" Program on weekends. This program is designed to encourage students to learn about astronomy fun and engagingly, incorporating theoretical concepts and practical learning activities.
